title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful capabilities available to everyone.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded files with a dedicated management area and flexible display options to perfectly present your content.

title: Track Our Progress with the New Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page offers a transparent overview of our recently shipped features, current developments, and exciting upcoming plans, keeping you informed about our product's evolution.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our enhanced checkboxes are now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, providing a smoother and more integrated task management experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Elevate your teamwork with refined editor collaboration tools, making real-time co-editing more intuitive and transparent.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Collaborate effortlessly as shared items are now fully integrated into search and easier to discover, boosting your team's productivity.

title: Noeko Goes Global
summary: Noeko will soon speak your language, connecting more users across the globe with comprehensive international language support.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with ultimate control and inviting direct collaboration to shape its future together.

title: Dynamic Graph Exploration
summary: Explore your interconnected ideas with new filtering and collaboration tools, making your knowledge graph a powerful workflow starter.

title: Enhanced Search and Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your information with powerful new filters and sorting options, allowing you to save tailored search views as curated collections for future reference.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize and interact with your interconnected notes, featuring dynamic display options that adapt to your workflow.

title: Noeko: Public Launch with Flexible Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official public release, empowering users with the choice of self-hosting and access to premium features through new flexible plans designed to fit every team.

title: Vibrant New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: We're enhancing our existing visual themes and introducing a vibrant array of new styles to bring a fresh look to your experience.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings on Your Homepage
summary: Get ready for personalized welcomes that truly match the time of day, as we ensure your homepage greeting is always perfectly accurate.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Experience a powerful new way to organize your content by quickly unapplying tags and performing other essential actions directly within your tag views.

title: Expand Your Content Library
summary: Get ready to seamlessly integrate a broader array of content, from web pages to YouTube videos, directly into your knowledge base for richer insights.
